meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或选题变成画面自创的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字素材,想快速做成讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn articles, notes, or a topic into an explainer video with invented visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have text material and want a quick explainer video.

howto.what: 把一段文字(文章、笔记、话题、提纲)做成无出镜解说视频:没有网站或素材可拍,每一帧的视觉都现编(排版、图形、示意图),最后渲染出 video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你把一段文字做成无出镜解说视频(话题解说、概念拆解、教程等)时接管;从网站取材的推广或导览视频不适用,意图不明时先走 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: Turns text (an article, notes, a topic, a brief) into a faceless explainer video: nothing is captured, so each scene's visuals are invented (typography, graphics, diagrams); it builds frames and renders video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you turn text into a faceless explainer video (topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles). Not for website-based videos (/product-launch-video); unclear → /hyperframes.
